simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לָהֵן (H3860) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: conj.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לָהֵן (lâhên) means properly for if ; hence, therefore First listed occurrence: Job 30 24.

definitions.usage: for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix).
definitions.full: H3860. lahen לָהֵן conjunction on this account, therefore , Ruth 1:13 (twice in verse) (either from לְ and הֵן (see below הֵ֫מָּה ); or the Aramaic לָהֵן Dan 2:6 , 9 ; 4:24 : see the Aramaic Lexicon) I. לָהֵן conjunction therefore (Biblical Hebrew לָהֵן Ruth 1:13 (twice in verse), Aramaic of Têma להן CIS ii. 113 = Cooke 195 ), Dan 2:6 , 9 ; 4:24 (Lambert RÉJ. 1904. 273 denies I. לָהֵן , taking Biblical Aramaic always as = רַק ).
